LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to describe where, when and how something happens? 2. How do you describe different actions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: A learner think of different ways to describe manner, time, and place

● Learning to learn: A learner identifies and use different types of adverbs

Values:
Responsibility: A learner record videos and describe the events with peers, they act responsibly

Link to other subjects:

● Kiswahili and Indigenous Languages have adverbs as a word class

● Physical Education and Sports, Agriculture and Home Science since learners describe processes using adverbs of
